response: Starting today, Saved Views is available to help you and your team work faster inside your projects. Instead of rebuilding filters, sorts, and groupings every time you open a list, you can now save your exact setup as a named view and return to it instantly. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team on a paid subscription can start using it right away at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, sprint, or client without worrying about running out of space. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters on their own. This makes it easier to stay aligned on priorities, keep onboarding simple for new teammates, and cut down on the back and forth of explaining how a board should be filtered. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
